title: Palindrome Partitioning III
summary: Given a string s with lowercase letters and an integer k, transform some characters to any lowercase letter and partition s into k non-empty palindromic substrings.
statement: Given a string s with lowercase letters and an integer k, transform some characters to any lowercase letter and partition s into k non-empty palindromic substrings. Determine the minimum number of character changes required for this partitioning.
constraints: Split s into exactly k nonempty contiguous substrings.
You may change individual characters; minimize changes needed to make every piece a palindrome.
hints: Precompute the mismatch cost to turn every substring into a palindrome.
Then partition prefixes: choose the start of the final piece and add its precomputed cost.
Fill by increasing prefix length and piece count.
Every exact-k partition has one final cut, so minimizing over all such cuts is exhaustive.
editorial: Every exact-k partition has one final cut, so minimizing over all such cuts is exhaustive.

tests.explanation: Split a and bc, then change one character in bc.
Split aa, bb, and c; no changes are needed.
